content: macOS menubar app conventions (Brink, AIQuota, Stats READMEs — cross-checked): accessory app with no Dock icon; Launch at login via SMAppService surfaced as a toggle; right-click context menu with Refresh now / settings / quit; manual refresh always available; Keychain access prompts (Allow Once vs Always Allow) and a cached-token file mode 0600 to avoid repeated prompts; hide providers the user is not signed in to rather than showing zeros; data-age display (when a reading was last updated, when an account needs attention — AIQuota); unreported values stay unavailable rather than rendering as zero usage (AIQuota).
